devtools::document()

```{r}
# 加载包
library(ICCDesign)

# 加载内置数据集
data(icc_data)

# 查看数据集
print(icc_data)
```



```{r}
# 测试1：ICC(1,1) - 单因素随机，单次评分
cat("=== Testing ICC(1,1) ===\n")
result1 <- icc_calc(icc_data, same_raters = FALSE, rating_type = "single", verbose = FALSE)
cat("ICC point estimate:", result1$icc_result$point_est, "\n")
cat("Reliability rating:", result1$evaluation$rating_en, "\n\n")

# 测试2：ICC(2,1) - 双因素随机，单次评分，绝对同意
cat("=== Testing ICC(2,1) ===\n")
result2 <- icc_calc(icc_data, same_raters = TRUE, rater_effect = "random",
                    rating_type = "single", agreement_type = "absolute", verbose = FALSE)
cat("ICC point estimate:", result2$icc_result$point_est, "\n")
cat("Reliability rating:", result2$evaluation$rating_en, "\n\n")

# 测试3：ICC(3,k) - 双因素混合，平均评分，一致性
cat("=== Testing ICC(3,k) ===\n")
result3 <- icc_calc(icc_data, same_raters = TRUE, rater_effect = "fixed",
                    rating_type = "average", agreement_type = "consistency", verbose = FALSE)
cat("ICC point estimate:", result3$icc_result$point_est, "\n")
cat("Reliability rating:", result3$evaluation$rating_en, "\n\n")

# 测试4：自动映射（随机+一致性）
cat("=== Testing automatic mapping ===\n")
result4 <- icc_calc(icc_data, same_raters = TRUE, rater_effect = "random",
                    rating_type = "single", agreement_type = "consistency", verbose = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# 测试1：基于下限的样本量计算
cat("=== Testing sample size (lower bound) ===\n")
n1 <- icc_sample_size(
  method = "lower",
  rho = 0.8,
  rho0 = 0.6,
  k = 3,
  same_raters = TRUE,
  rater_effect = "random",
  rating_type = "single",
  agreement_type = "absolute",
  verbose = FALSE
)
cat("Required sample size:", n1, "\n\n")

# 测试2：基于宽度的样本量计算
cat("=== Testing sample size (width) ===\n")
n2 <- icc_sample_size(
  method = "width",
  rho = 0.7,
  omega = 0.1,
  k = 3,
  same_raters = FALSE,
  rating_type = "average",
  verbose = FALSE
)
cat("Required sample size:", n2, "\n\n")

# 测试3：功效计算
cat("=== Testing power calculation ===\n")
power <- icc_sample_size(
  method = "power",
  n = 30,
  rho = 0.7,
  rho0 = 0.5,
  k = 3,
  same_raters = TRUE,
  rater_effect = "fixed",
  rating_type = "single",
  agreement_type = "consistency",
  verbose = FALSE
)
cat("Estimated power:", sprintf("%.1f%%", power * 100), "\n")
```


```{r}
# 启动Shiny应用
run_icc_app()
```
